# Tirupati Coolers

> Tirupati Coolers is a cooler company based in Surat, Gujarat, India. This website provides a product catalogue and direct WhatsApp enquiry path.

## Main pages

- [Home](/): Brand introduction, catalogue preview, selection guide, and contact section.
- [Catalogue](/catalogue): Browse and filter available cooler categories.
- [Search](/search): Search products by name, category, or intended setting.

## Catalogue status

Product models, images, specifications, certifications, contact details, and performance claims are awaiting verification. The current catalogue uses clearly identified category previews and should not be treated as a final technical source.

## Contact

Location: Surat, Gujarat, India

The verified WhatsApp number will be published before launch.
